name: Kunnin' as a Snarlfang
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, until the end of the turn friendly units wholly within 12" of the general have +1 Rend on their melee weapons. Companion weapons are not affected.

name: Glare of Frazzlegit
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with the general. Until the end of the turn, subtract 1 from that unit's hit rolls.

name: Sunsteala Shard
text: Once per battle, in the enemy shooting phase, until the end of the turn friendly units wholly within 6" of the general cannot be picked as the target of a shooting attack, unless the attacker is in combat with that unit.

name: Devious Backstabba
text: At the end of any turn, pick an enemy Hero in combat with the general's unit and roll a D3. On a 2+, that Hero suffers that much mortal damage.
